intro.text: A Hallandren writing system built on color rather than shape: each color stands for a sound of the language.

description.text: The simplest form uses plain dots of color. Skilled writers use lines that shade gradually from one color to another, or glyphs that make pictures.
Using the script to the full takes the perfect color sense granted by the Third Heightening.
Because their tongues are removed, Hallandren's God Kings are taught to communicate through the artisan's script.
